title: Expose the ArchMap Next topology model as first-class DSL
description: Add a native topology YAML section for Resources, Container Boundaries, Overlay Boundaries, and direct communication Edges, then derive crossings and project the authored facts into existing renderers without breaking legacy documents.
completion_criteria: parse() preserves a native topology section on ArchMapModel.
Resources and direct Resource-to-Resource Edges are usable by existing 2D renderers through a compatibility projection.
Container forest, endpoint, overlay membership, and derived crossing diagnostics run for native topology input.
Authored crossing or analysis output is rejected as derived-only data.
A native Next sample, syntax reference, AI authoring guidance, focused tests, QIF evidence, and browser verification are complete.
evidence: Native topology parser, compatibility projection, canonical retention, analysis validation, sample, documentation, and focused tests are implemented.
Focused topology suite passed 34 tests; full regression passed 332 tests; typecheck and production build passed.
Browser smoke rendered 5 Resources, 6 Containers, 1 Overlay, and 4 Edges with zero errors and zero warnings.
notes: The native topology is the semantic source of truth. Existing nodes/zones/boundaries/edges are populated only as a compatibility renderer bridge. Provider-specific rules remain validator extensions.
